about: What each K1 jack pin does. Pin numbers = the order of 'pins' in k1_jacks.json (rev 10 header: 1-5 = 3.5 pins 2,1,3,4,5; 6-10 = 2.5 pins 2,1,3,4,5). Mapped 2026-10-27 on a rev 10 board with a Jumperless V5 continuity sweep, plugs in and plugs out; every connection seen from both ends. A switch pin touches its contact pin with no plug in and opens when a plug goes in.
assumption: 2.5 tip/ring/sleeve assumes its plug pigtail uses the colours checked on the 3.5 pigtail (red = tip, white = ring, black = sleeve).
